extracted.stage: Before grant of probate; inheritance tax due
extracted.summary: An executor of his late mother's estate, mainly a house in Chester worth about £194,500, asks to borrow around £52,000 to pay inheritance tax before the grant of probate is issued.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for getting in touch with Lodestar Legal Finance about funding the inheritance tax on your late mother's estate. We have noted that the estate is principally a property in Chester valued at around £194,500 and that approximately £52,000 is needed, with Osei Osei Solicitors LLP instructed. To take this further we would need a copy of the will and confirmation of your appointment as executor, the draft IHT account or HMRC calculation, a valuation of the property, details of any other estate assets, debts or mortgages, your solicitor's written confirmation that they act, and any date by which the tax must be paid. Once we have those we can review the enquiry and come back to you; nothing in this message is an offer of finance or confirmation that funding is available.
